Name: mode
Comment: Extend existing enum: "txt2img" | "img2img" | "txt2vid" | "img2vid" | "flf2vid". "txt2vid" is the default Wan path. "img2vid" enables Wan-Fun image-to-video. "flf2vid" enables first-last-frame (Wan-Fun FLF) where both initImageBytes and endImageBytes are required.

Name: files.diffusionModel
Comment: Path to Wan 2.1 transformer GGUF (e.g. wan2.1-t2v-1.3b-Q8_0.gguf). Already exists in addon -- reused, just documented here for completeness.

Name: files.highNoiseDiffusionModel
Comment: NEW. Path to Wan 2.2 MoE high-noise expert GGUF. Leave undefined for Wan 2.1 (single-expert).

Name: files.t5Xxl
Comment: Path to umt5-xxl encoder GGUF used by Wan. Reused from existing ctx.

Name: files.vae
Comment: Path to Wan VAE GGUF. Reused.

Name: endImageBytes
Comment: NEW. Raw PNG/JPEG bytes for the final frame. Required for "flf2vid". Optional for "img2vid". Sibling field to the existing initImageBytes on GenerationJob.

Name: controlFramesBytes
Comment: NEW. Optional VACE control frames (one Uint8Array per frame, in order). Used by Wan VACE control. Empty / undefined disables VACE.

Name: videoFrames
Comment: NEW. Total output frames. Wan 2.1 T2V 1.3B sweet spot: 81 frames @ 16 fps == ~5 s. Must be (4*k + 1).

Name: fps
Comment: NEW. Output framerate written into the AVI container header. Does NOT affect denoising; only encoder metadata. Default 16.

Name: flowShift
Comment: NEW. Rectified-flow timestep shift. Wan 2.1 T2V 1.3B recommended: 5.0-8.0 (CLI default 3.0 looks washed out / black). Set per-job.

Name: vaceStrength
Comment: NEW. VACE control strength in [0, 1]. 0 = ignore controlFramesBytes. Default 1.0 when control frames are provided.

Name: moeBoundary
Comment: NEW (Wan 2.2 only). Timestep boundary in [0, 1] at which sampling switches from low-noise to high-noise expert. Ignored if highNoiseDiffusionModel is unset. Default 0.875.

Name: highNoiseSampler
Comment: NEW (Wan 2.2 only). Same enum as sampler. Sampler used during the high-noise phase. Defaults to sampler when unset.

Name: highNoiseScheduler
Comment: NEW (Wan 2.2 only). Same enum as scheduler. Scheduler for high-noise phase.

Name: highNoiseSteps
Comment: NEW (Wan 2.2 only). Step count for high-noise phase. 0 / unset = mirror steps.

Name: highNoiseCfgScale
Comment: NEW (Wan 2.2 only). CFG scale for high-noise phase. 0 / unset = mirror cfgScale.

Name: highNoiseFlowShift
Comment: NEW (Wan 2.2 only). flow_shift for high-noise phase. 0 / unset = mirror flowShift.

Name: videoCallback
Comment: NEW. Fires once when the AVI is fully encoded; receives a Uint8Array of MJPG-AVI bytes. Caller writes to disk or pipes to ffmpeg. Mutually exclusive with outputCallback in vid modes.

Name: frameCallback
Comment: NEW (optional). Per-frame PNG callback: (frameIdx, totalFrames, pngBytes) => void. Useful when the caller wants to assemble the video themselves (H.264 via ffmpeg, etc.).
